			if = {
				limit = { omni_mage_tower_can_pay = { PRICE = omni_tower_price_summon_elemental_colossus } }
				omni_pay_mage_tower_price = { PRICE = omni_tower_price_summon_elemental_colossus }
				scope:omni_mage_tower_site = { remove_list_variable = { name = omni_tower_books target = flag:summon_elemental_colossus } }
				scope:omni_city_visitor = { omni_learn_spell = { SPELL = summon_elemental_colossus } }
			}
			else = { custom_tooltip = omni_tower_cannot_afford_tt }
		}
		trigger_event = { id = omni_tower.1 }
	}

	option = {
		name = omni_tower_buy_cataclysmic_eruption
		trigger = {
			omni_mage_tower_visit_is_current = yes
			scope:omni_mage_tower_site = { has_variable = omni_tower_restock_timer is_target_in_variable_list = { name = omni_tower_books target = flag:cataclysmic_eruption } }
			scope:omni_city_visitor = {
				omni_can_learn_academy_magic = yes
				NOT = { has_variable = cataclysmic_eruption_known_var }
				omni_sb_knows_melodian_t3_count = yes
				omni_sb_any_t4_access = yes
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = omni_sb_effect_cataclysmic_eruption
		if = {
			limit = {
				omni_mage_tower_visit_is_current = yes
				scope:omni_mage_tower_site = { has_variable = omni_tower_restock_timer is_target_in_variable_list = { name = omni_tower_books target = flag:cataclysmic_eruption } }
				scope:omni_city_visitor = {
					omni_can_learn_academy_magic = yes
					NOT = { has_variable = cataclysmic_eruption_known_var }
					omni_sb_knows_melodian_t3_count = yes
					omni_sb_any_t4_access = yes
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { omni_mage_tower_can_pay = { PRICE = omni_tower_price_cataclysmic_eruption } }
				omni_pay_mage_tower_price = { PRICE = omni_tower_price_cataclysmic_eruption }
				scope:omni_mage_tower_site = { remove_list_variable = { name = omni_tower_books target = flag:cataclysmic_eruption } }
				scope:omni_city_visitor = { omni_learn_spell = { SPELL = cataclysmic_eruption } }
			}
			else = { custom_tooltip = omni_tower_cannot_afford_tt }
		}
		trigger_event = { id = omni_tower.1 }
	}

	option = { name = omni_items.back trigger_event = { id = omni_items.16 } }
	option = { name = omni_items.1.close }
}
